messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up: brought up reranker v4-ptq-perlayer on validation. NDCG@10 +1.4% but MRR@1 -4.5%. Flagging for triage.

Rafael: hmm big MRR@1 drop usually = top-1 flips. candidate order/normalization diffs?

Anya: same candidate pool & seed. PTQ used per-layer min-max with batch calibration (1k examples from prod-like traffic).

Priya: did the calibration set include short queries? PTQ can collapse head variance if short queries are underrepresented.

Anya: calibration mean query len 18, but holdout short-query median is 6. good call.

Ben: paste eval command + score percentiles please.

Anya: eval command run; percentiles (float vs ptq):
float p1=-0.6 p50=0.14 p99=1.5
ptq p1=-0.08 p50=0.06 p99=0.9
Range contracted significantly.

Rafael: try two experiments: 1) re-calibrate with stratified sample (include short queries) 2) asymmetric activation quant (preserve negative tail).

Anya: kicked off stratified-calib job with 20% short queries. eval-bot: job_351900 started (Anya).

Ben: also try a tiny post-quant affine on logits (alpha/beta) as a quick mitigation.

Anya: post-affine alpha=1.6 beta=-0.02 -> MRR@1 recovered to -0.6% vs float, NDCG@10 +1.1%.

Anya: stratified calib + asymmetric acts -> MRR@1 -0.2%, NDCG@10 +1.3%. Best so far.

Priya: per-query diffs show flips concentrated on queries <=8 tokens and candidate sets >30. Collected ~1.9k flips; 78% <=8 tokens.

Rafael: root cause: calibration sampling skew + symmetric clipping. Short queries produce sharp logits that get squashed. Asymmetric + stratified calib preserves head variance.

Ben: actionables: 1) default onboarding: stratified calibration matching traffic slices 2) prefer asymmetric activations for reranker architecture 3) document optional post-quant rescale in model card + canary.

Rafael: add unit test: when quantizing assert p1/p99 ratio within [0.25,1.25] of float baseline or flag for review.

Ben: created INF-1432 for quant-onboard-checks + thresholds, assigned to infra+eval.

Anya: PR to include calibration sampling config, asym acts flag, optional post-rescale hook. Will run canary. eval-bot: job_351900 finished; artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/351900/.

Priya: model-card note suggestion: "Calibration: stratified (short/medium/long), Quant: per-channel weights, asymmetric activations, post-quant rescale alpha=1.6 beta=-0.02 (canary only)"

Anya: adding small regression dashboard charting p1/p50/p99 and top1-flip-count across releases.

Rafael: that + INF-1432 should prevent repeats.

Anya: thanks all. Follow-ups: PR+canary, INF-1432, dashboard. Closing unless new regressions. :white_check_mark:
